Doses should also be re- duced in hepatic impairment and in patients with mas- sive liver metastases (but see also below). In the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer, vinorel- bine is also given orally at a dose of 60 mg/m2 once weekly for 3 weeks. Subsequent doses may be in- creased to 80 mg/m2, unless the neutrophil count falls below 500 cells/mm3, or to between 500 and 1000 cells/mm3 on two separate occasions, in which case the dose is kept at 60 mg/m2 for the next 3 doses. ◊ References. 1.
